# Awareness Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AwarenessLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The graded level of arousal or vigilance — how alert the experiencer is, on an ordinal ladder from hyperalert down to unresponsive. A value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) of six rungs ([`gmeow:levelHyperalert`](../individuals/gmeow-levelHyperalert.md) … [`gmeow:levelUnresponsive`](../individuals/gmeow-levelUnresponsive.md)), each carrying an integer [`gmeow:levelRank`](../properties/gmeow-levelRank.md) (5 high → 0 low) for ordering. The named, ordinal companion of the continuous [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessScalar.md); distinct from [`gmeow:AwarenessMode`](gmeow-AwarenessMode.md), which names the qualitative STATE rather than its arousal intensity.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the graded arousal of an experiencer — the named rungs of the alertness ladder a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) or agent declares through [`gmeow:awarenessLevel`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessLevel.md), when a discrete clinical-style level is wanted rather than a continuous [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessScalar.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing it to add a rung (members are individuals) and avoid using it for the qualitative STATE (that is [`gmeow:AwarenessMode`](gmeow-AwarenessMode.md)); for a continuous normalised arousal value use [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessScalar.md) instead of, or alongside, the named level.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded level individual via [`gmeow:awarenessLevel`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessLevel.md); read the ordering off [`gmeow:levelRank`](../properties/gmeow-levelRank.md) (high arousal = high rank); pair with or substitute the continuous [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessScalar.md) when a finer-grained value is available.

### Scope notes

- Ordinal arousal, distinct from mode ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) grades HOW alert an experiencer is, where [`gmeow:AwarenessMode`](gmeow-AwarenessMode.md) names WHICH state it is in — a [`gmeow:modeAsleep`](../individuals/gmeow-modeAsleep.md) agent carries [`gmeow:levelUnresponsive`](../individuals/gmeow-levelUnresponsive.md), a [`gmeow:modeFocused`](../individuals/gmeow-modeFocused.md) agent [`gmeow:levelAlert`](../individuals/gmeow-levelAlert.md), and the two axes co-apply. The lowest rungs ([`gmeow:levelObtunded`](../individuals/gmeow-levelObtunded.md), [`gmeow:levelUnresponsive`](../individuals/gmeow-levelUnresponsive.md)) map to the Glasgow Coma Scale by reference; the ranks order the rungs without asserting a metric scale.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:levelAlert`](../individuals/gmeow-levelAlert.md) a [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md); [`gmeow:levelRank`](../properties/gmeow-levelRank.md) 4.
